build_oauth_auth: build an httpx.Auth-compatible OAuth handler for an MCP server with server name, URL, and optional oauth config dict
create_HermesTokenStorage: create a HermesTokenStorage instance that persists OAuth tokens and client info to JSON files on disk
test_HermesTokenStorage_get_tokens: test the HermesTokenStorage.get_tokens method to load and validate cached OAuth tokens from disk
review_HermesTokenStorage_set_tokens: review the HermesTokenStorage.set_tokens method that persists OAuth tokens with an absolute expires_at for cross-process expiry correctness
summarize_build_oauth_auth: summarize the build_oauth_auth function that configures callback port, client metadata, optional pre-registration, and returns an OAuthClientProvider
